THE PEOPLE & PURPOSE

Rooted in connection.
Open to possibility.

Our story begins with the belief that healing is a collective journey.

OUR ETHOS

A space to feel
seen and supported.

Sacred Origins NYC is a collective dedicated to empowering BIPOC communities through sacred healing practices. We recognize that personal reflection and community connection can bring us closer to the wisdom and resilience of our ancestors.

Our offerings include Reiki, Earth Medicine Ceremonies, retreats, and spaces for meaningful conversation. We welcome each person with care and respect for their individual path.
